title: Te Pā i Wāwāhi i te Kīngitanga
intro: He whenua e rere ana ngā awa, e rua ngā māra matomato, me te whai rawa kore - engari i wareware ōna tāngata ki te Mea nāna rātou i manaaki. I te taenga mai o ngā whakamaharatanga ki te karanga i a rātou kia hoki mai, ka tahuri ke atu rātou. Ko te mea i whai ake ko te whiu e mau tonu ana hei whakatūpato. Ko wai tēnei hapori tawhito?
clues: I noho mātou i tētahi whenua manaakitanga, i waenganui i ngā māra matomato e rua tō mātou kāinga.
I pai mātou ki ngā awa e rere ana i roto i ō mātou whenua, me ngā hua nui e whakakī ana i ō mātou kāinga.
Heoi i te wā i karangatia ai tātou kia whakawhetai, kia ngohengohe hoki ki tō tātou Ariki, ka tahuri ke atu tātou i runga i te whakapehapeha.
Nā ō mātou taonga me ō mātou wātea i wareware ai mātou ki te Atua nāna nei i homai te katoa.
Kātahi ka puta whakarere mai he waipuke, ā, pakaru ana i te ārai nui i whakawhirinaki atu ai mātou.
Ko mātou te iwi o Saba', i mōhiotia tō mātou whenua mō te pā wai nui o Ma'rib.

Ngā tāngata o te awaawa
Ngā Hoa o te Puna

Ngā tāngata o Miriana

trial.label: Tō tātou hinganga
options: Waipuke mai i te pāhūtanga o te tāhuna
He hau kaha mai i te rangi
Te tahunga i roto i te awaawa ahi
He rū whenua nui
Te toremitanga i roto i te waipuke nui
trial.answer: Waipuke mai i te pāhūtanga o te tāhuna

outcome.label: Tō tātou aituā

outcome.answer: E rua ngā māra kawa i whakakapi i ā mātou māra matomato

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
